{{Quote|I placed a single operative in charge of the Power Guard project. Gave him unlimited authority and enough credits to fund the program.|Var Suthra|<ref name="Power" />}}
An '''operative''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was placed in charge of developing [[Power Guard Enhancement System]], a [[Soldier/Legends|supersoldier]] project created by the [[Republic superweapon initiative]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Granted unlimited authority and a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] by the initiative's leader, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], the operative progressed with the Power Guard project on the neutral [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in absolute secrecy.<ref name="Power" /> However, in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the project was uncovered by the Empire and the man was [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] to [[Death/Legends|death]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]]. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency, tracked down the operative in the district known as the [[Nikto Sector]], and discovered that the Imperials had stolen data files on the project from the man's body.<ref name="Galen">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Search for Agent Galen|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic operative was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. First discussed in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class mission "The Power Guard Project,"<ref name="Power" /> the operative's fate is revealed in the subsequent mission "The Search for Agent Galen," but neither mention reveals his name or [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Galen" />
